title: Specialty Pharmacy Program Coverage Clause: Exclusive Dispensing and Outside-Pharmacy Fills
content:
**Clause.** On every tier of the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the drugs on the program's specialty drug list are managed by the specialty program.

- **Where the tier makes Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy the exclusive specialty pharmacy**, a specialty drug dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy or a retail pharmacy is covered for at most the tier's number of outside courtesy fills per drug per plan year. Later outside fills are not covered, and the member pays the pharmacy in full.
- **Where the tier does not make it exclusive**, any network specialty pharmacy may dispense. A fill at an outside specialty pharmacy adds the tier's outside-pharmacy coinsurance addition, as a share of the allowed amount, to the member's cost share.
- **Enrollment.** Courtesy fills do not need an enrollment. A member who wants Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy to dispense needs an active enrollment.

## Counting outside fills

Outside fills are counted per drug over the current plan year of the member's plan enrollment, from the plan year's start date through today, inclusive. The count includes every shipped or paid fill of the same drug that was dispensed by an outside specialty pharmacy or by a retail pharmacy.

## Branches

| Tier setting | Dispensing pharmacy | Result for the fill |
|---|---|---|
| Exclusive | Northbridge Specialty Pharmacy, with an active enrollment | Dispensed under the program |
| Exclusive | Outside specialty pharmacy or retail pharmacy, within the courtesy fills for the drug this plan year | Covered as a courtesy fill; no enrollment needed |
| Exclusive | Outside specialty pharmacy or retail pharmacy, after the courtesy fills for the drug this plan year are used | Not covered; the member pays the pharmacy in full |
| Not exclusive | Any network specialty pharmacy | May dispense |
| Not exclusive | Outside specialty pharmacy | The outside-pharmacy coinsurance addition of the allowed amount is added to the member's cost share |

## Cases (assumed facts)

- *Exclusive tier with one courtesy fill per drug per plan year; no outside fill of Rinvoq yet this plan year; the member fills Rinvoq at a retail pharmacy.* That fill is the first outside fill this plan year, so it is covered.
- *Same tier; one outside fill of Rinvoq is already on record this plan year; the member fills Rinvoq at an outside specialty pharmacy again.* The single courtesy fill is used, so this fill is not covered and the member pays the pharmacy in full.
- *Non-exclusive tier with an outside-pharmacy addition of 10%; an outside specialty pharmacy fill with an assumed allowed amount of $2,000.00.* The member's cost share is increased by $200.00.
